records.source_statement: Lilly first requires the exact time of first falling sick, as nearly as the hour can be obtained: when the person first became so ill or extremely oppressed that bed or repose was compelled.

source_clauses: Seeking the first-choice inception time for this sickness judgment.

condition_logic.expression: Use the nearest obtainable hour of first enforced bed or repose because of illness.

qualifications_and_limits: He expressly excludes the first moment the patient merely felt a smatch of illness.

records.source_statement: Lilly directs counting how many degrees the malevolent planet lacks before leaving the sign, then judging that many months, weeks, or days according to the sign’s nature and quality.

source_clauses: The preceding sixth-house unfortunate-planet sign-exit configuration applies.
The question asks when or how long before the disease alters.

qualifications_and_limits: No determinate month/week/day selection rule is supplied in this passage.
No rounding or partial-degree rule is supplied.
